title: A Light Above Glassridge
body: A quiet dockhand says a Glassridge penthouse will be empty for one rain-heavy night. The tip is thin, but the view from that hill has tempted better people than you.

outcomes.title: The lead is real
outcomes.body: You confirm just enough to make the possibility dangerous.

choices.text: Let the hill keep its secrets

outcomes.title: Lights stay distant
outcomes.body: You watch Glassridge glitter without adding your shadow to it.

title: Glassridge Prep
body: Your crew gathers in a borrowed office while rain turns the windows black. Everyone understands the lead could make a name or make a grave mistake.

outcomes.title: Ready enough
outcomes.body: You set expectations, exits, and limits without pretending the night is safe.

outcomes.title: No night job
outcomes.body: The crew is disappointed, but nobody is explaining themselves to a judge tomorrow.

outcomes.title: Rushed planning
outcomes.body: The crew follows your urgency, not your wisdom.

title: Glassridge Night
body: The hill is swallowed by rain and every window holds a distorted reflection. The job goes louder than anyone promised, and the city below feels suddenly very far away.

outcomes.title: Through the rain
outcomes.body: You get out with a haul and a story Ravenport will reshape by morning.

outcomes.title: Lights on the hill
outcomes.body: A siren finds the road before you do. The score becomes evidence.

outcomes.title: Empty-handed escape
outcomes.body: You leave the promise behind and keep the people beside you breathing.

outcomes.title: A brutal exit
outcomes.body: You force the night forward and pay in blood and attention.
outcomes.log: Was badly injured in the Glassridge job.

title: Glassridge Fallout
body: After Glassridge, strangers recognize you in places they should not. Money changes hands, old friends speak cautiously, and every favor now comes with a memory.

outcomes.title: Names held close
outcomes.body: The crew believes the victory belongs to all of you, which buys a rare kind of calm.

outcomes.title: A lonely crown
outcomes.body: The money is yours, but the glances around you have changed.

choices.text: Put the money toward legitimate work

outcomes.title: A different foundation
outcomes.body: You put the windfall into something that might survive the story of how it arrived.

title: Harbor Crown: First Tide
body: The Calderas start squeezing dockside friends who have been speaking your name. The port feels like it belongs to the family until you notice how many workers resent being told so.

outcomes.title: A stand at the water
outcomes.body: People choose a side quietly, then all at once.

outcomes.title: Tide recedes
outcomes.body: You avoid a war and surrender a little ground.
outcomes.log: Yielded dock influence to the Calderas.

outcomes.title: The crowd answers
outcomes.body: Your nerve turns frustration into movement.

title: Harbor Crown: Storm Tide
body: A strike, a sabotage rumor, and a police patrol converge on the same gray morning. The Calderas expect you to panic before the workers do.

outcomes.title: The line holds
outcomes.body: You keep people together long enough for the Caldera pressure to crack.
outcomes.log: Held the docks through a Caldera push.

outcomes.title: Saltwater truce
outcomes.body: The deal is temporary, but it stops today from becoming a catastrophe.
outcomes.log: Sought a Caldera truce at the docks.

outcomes.title: Storm violence
outcomes.body: The docks become a scene nobody can control. You survive, but Ravenport collects the cost.

title: Harbor Crown: Reckoning
body: The Calderas ask for one last meeting at the harbor as fog erases the far shore. Whoever leaves with the workers’ trust will own more than territory.

outcomes.title: Crown shared
outcomes.body: You win recognition without pretending the water belongs to anyone forever.

outcomes.title: Harbor crown
outcomes.body: The city starts calling the waterfront yours, for better and worse.

outcomes.title: A different victory
outcomes.body: You refuse to build a throne from exhausted people.

title: The DA File Opens
body: Your lawyer calls before sunrise: the district attorney has opened a file with your name on it. The city you know becomes a map of possible witnesses.

outcomes.title: Counsel retained
outcomes.body: You put a professional wall between panic and the state.
outcomes.log: Retained counsel for the DA file.

outcomes.title: Facts arrive anyway
outcomes.body: You save your money but lose the first move.

outcomes.title: Worry buried badly
outcomes.body: The case grows while you tell yourself it cannot.

title: The DA File: Discovery
body: Boxes of documents arrive, each page a version of your life written by someone who wants a conviction. Your lawyer circles a few lines in red.

outcomes.title: Pattern found
outcomes.body: A contradiction gives the defense somewhere to stand.

outcomes.title: Trust counsel
outcomes.body: You spare yourself the details and surrender some control.

outcomes.title: Fresh trouble
outcomes.body: The attempt becomes a new concern for the prosecution.
outcomes.log: Made a damaging witness pressure attempt.

title: The DA File: Crossroads
body: The prosecutor offers a narrow deal while your lawyer says the case is not as strong as it once looked. No choice feels clean; each one simply leads to a different kind of memory.

outcomes.title: Years counted
outcomes.body: You choose certainty and prepare to lose time, not yourself.

outcomes.title: Case tested
outcomes.body: The courtroom becomes the place where strangers argue about who you are.
outcomes.log: Took the DA case to trial.

outcomes.title: A terrible bargain
outcomes.body: You gain a way out and lose a piece of your old world.

title: The DA File: Resolution
body: Years after the first call, a final order waits in a courtroom hallway. The building has not changed, but you have.

outcomes.title: File closed
outcomes.body: Whatever the cost, the file stops deciding your every morning.

outcomes.title: One more door
outcomes.body: You refuse to let the last ruling be the last word.

choices.text: Turn it into a new life

outcomes.title: Life redirected
outcomes.body: You leave the courthouse with no illusions and one better intention.

title: Blood Ledger: The Accountant
body: The accountant arrives with a leather folder and a look that makes numbers feel judgmental. They can clean the books, but clean books create their own trail.

outcomes.title: Books opened
outcomes.body: You give a stranger access to the truth behind your money.

outcomes.title: No new eyes
outcomes.body: You keep your privacy and your disarray.

title: Blood Ledger: Irregularity
body: The accountant finds a recurring irregularity that could be error, theft, or a signal from someone inside your circle. Their voice stays calm; yours does not.

outcomes.title: The missing pattern
outcomes.body: You trace the problem without accusing the wrong person.

outcomes.title: Trust breaks
outcomes.body: They leave with a stiff expression and knowledge you wish they did not carry.

outcomes.title: Proof found
outcomes.body: The test reveals an outside pressure on the accountant, not their greed.

title: Blood Ledger: Verdict
body: The ledger closes on an explanation, but not necessarily a clean one. The accountant waits across the desk to learn whether you still see them as an ally.

outcomes.title: Books steady
outcomes.body: You choose oversight over paranoia and preserve a useful partnership.

outcomes.title: Books change hands
outcomes.body: You pay for transition and live with the unresolved question.

choices.text: Ask them to hide the problem

outcomes.title: A dangerous favor
outcomes.body: They agree reluctantly, and the books become another secret with teeth.
outcomes.log: Asked accountant to conceal an irregularity.

title: Family Fracture: First Question
body: Your teenage child asks why certain adults lower their voices when you enter. There is no safe lie left, only kinder and crueler truths.

outcomes.title: A seed of trust
outcomes.body: They do not like the answer, but they believe you meant it.
outcomes.log: Told a child a careful truth.

outcomes.title: A seed of distance
outcomes.body: They accept it for now, and start looking elsewhere for answers.
outcomes.log: Lied to a child about your life.

outcomes.title: A different promise
outcomes.body: You make a promise to protect their future from your past.
outcomes.log: Promised a child a better path.

title: Family Fracture: The Offer
body: Now grown, your child brings you three offers: a scholarship, a role beside you, and a message from someone who wants to use your family name against you.

outcomes.title: A lawful door
outcomes.body: You pay what you can and make clear they owe you nothing for it.

outcomes.title: Near the flame
outcomes.body: They step into your orbit with open eyes and a complicated smile.
outcomes.log: Brought adult child into family orbit.

choices.text: Let them take the rival meeting

outcomes.title: A dangerous door
outcomes.body: You cannot control the choice once they make it, only what you do next.
outcomes.log: Allowed child to meet a rival.

title: Family Fracture: Echo
body: Years later, your child’s choice has become a shape in every family gathering. A letter arrives asking for one private conversation, without witnesses.

outcomes.title: A conversation begins
outcomes.body: The two of you say difficult things and leave a little less alone.
outcomes.log: Met child to repair a family rift.

outcomes.title: Distance hardens
outcomes.body: The letter stays unanswered until the paper feels older than the wound.

outcomes.title: A bridge offered
outcomes.body: You refuse to make forgiveness another transaction.

title: Family Fracture: Legacy
body: At a family table years from now, the younger generation watches how you and your child greet one another. The lesson is not in the words; it is in what survives them.

outcomes.title: Legacy softened
outcomes.body: You speak plainly about mistakes and the work of coming back.
outcomes.log: Named family repair as your legacy.

outcomes.title: A narrower inheritance
outcomes.body: The room obeys your voice, but nobody mistakes obedience for love.

outcomes.title: Legacy released
outcomes.body: You tell them the family name is not a sentence.
outcomes.log: Released the next generation from your shadow.

title: Wedding Circuit: Courtship
body: You meet someone who laughs at Ravenport’s false glamour and sees the fatigue behind yours. They ask for coffee in daylight, which feels more dangerous than any midnight invitation.

outcomes.title: Daylight honesty
outcomes.body: You talk until the café stacks chairs around you.

outcomes.title: Phone silent
outcomes.body: You keep the city at arm’s length by keeping everyone there.

outcomes.title: A real spark
outcomes.body: Your charm lands because it is paired with attention.

title: Wedding Circuit: Families
body: Both families gather for dinner and immediately find reasons to worry about one another. You can make the evening a contest, or make it a beginning.

outcomes.title: Dinner survives
outcomes.body: You tell a story that lets everyone laugh before they harden.

outcomes.title: Dinner fractures
outcomes.body: Old loyalties turn a meal into an argument nobody wins.

outcomes.title: Patience at table
outcomes.body: The sharpest voices soften when they are not interrupted.

title: Wedding Circuit: Vows
body: The city looks almost gentle from the courthouse steps. The person beside you asks whether you are ready to promise something Ravenport cannot guarantee.

outcomes.title: Vows kept
outcomes.body: You say yes with your whole, imperfect history standing behind you.

outcomes.title: More time
outcomes.body: You choose honesty over a promise made from fear.

outcomes.title: Quiet vows
outcomes.body: You make the commitment without an audience to complicate it.
